SELECT
r.operator_id, MAX(u.nickname) AS operator_name, MAX(d.name) AS dept_name,
r.operator_id, MAX(u.nickname) AS operator_name, MAX(d.name) AS dept_name, op.work_center_id, MAX(w.name) AS work_center_name, op.name AS op_name,
r.operator_id, MAX(u.nickname) AS operator_name, MAX(d.name) AS dept_name, r.report_date AS day,
op.work_center_id, MAX(w.name) AS work_center_name,
op.work_center_id, MAX(w.name) AS work_center_name, op.name AS op_name,
o.material_id AS product_id, MAX(p.code) AS product_code, MAX(p.name) AS product_name, MAX(p.unit) AS unit,
r.report_date AS day,
YEAR(r.report_date) * 100 + MONTH(r.report_date) AS period,
GROUP BY
r.operator_id r.operator_id, op.work_center_id, op.name r.operator_id, r.report_date op.work_center_id op.work_center_id, op.name o.material_id r.report_date YEAR(r.report_date) * 100 + MONTH(r.report_date)
ORDER BY
operator_name, r.operator_id, day day period piece_wage DESC, good_qty DESC good_qty DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.id AS wo_id, o.wo_no, o.wo_type, o.status, o.plan_start, o.plan_end, o.finish_time, o.close_time, o.material_id AS product_id, p.code AS product_code, p.name AS product_name, p.unit, o.dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, o.qty, o.finished_qty, o.scrap_qty
ORDER BY o.plan_end, o.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
o.material_id AS product_id, MAX(p.code) AS product_code, MAX(p.name) AS product_name, MAX(p.unit) AS unit,
o.dept_id, MAX(d.name) AS dept_name, YEAR(o.plan_end) * 100 + MONTH(o.plan_end) AS period,
COUNT(*) AS wo_count, SUM(o.qty) AS qty, SUM(o.finished_qty) AS finished_qty, SUM(o.scrap_qty) AS scrap_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND CAST(o.finish_time AS DATE) <= o.plan_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND CAST(o.finish_time AS DATE) > o.plan_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND o.plan_end < #{today} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count
GROUP BY
o.material_id o.dept_id YEAR(o.plan_end) * 100 + MONTH(o.plan_end)
ORDER BY
period wo_count DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
o.material_id AS product_id, MAX(p.code) AS product_code, MAX(p.name) AS product_name, MAX(p.spec) AS spec, MAX(p.unit) AS unit, MAX(p.category) AS category,
p.category, o.dept_id, MAX(dp.name) AS dept_name, x.biz_date AS day, YEAR(x.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(x.biz_date) AS period,
SUM(CASE WHEN x.kind = 'FINISH' THEN x.total_qty ELSE 0 END) AS finish_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN x.kind = 'SCRAP' THEN x.total_qty ELSE 0 END) AS scrap_in_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN x.kind = 'FINISH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finish_count, COUNT(DISTINCT x.wo_id) AS wo_count, SUM(CASE WHEN x.kind = 'FINISH' THEN COALESCE(x.material_cost, 0) + COALESCE(x.labor_cost, 0) + COALESCE(x.overhead_cost, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS finish_cost FROM mes_wo_doc x JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = x.wo_id JOIN wms_material p ON p.id = o.material_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept dp ON dp.id = o.dept_id WHERE x.kind IN ('FINISH', 'SCRAP') AND x.biz_date >= #{q.begin} AND x.biz_date <= #{q.end} AND o.material_id = #{q.productId} AND p.category = #{q.category} AND o.dept_id = #{q.deptId}
AND (p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY
o.material_id p.category o.dept_id x.biz_date YEAR(x.biz_date) * 100 + MONTH(x.biz_date)
ORDER BY
day period finish_qty DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
x.material_id, MAX(m.code) AS material_code, MAX(m.name) AS material_name, MAX(m.spec) AS spec, MAX(m.unit) AS unit, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS wo_count, SUM(o.finished_qty * x.unit_qty) AS std_qty, SUM(x.issued_qty) AS actual_qty
o.id AS wo_id, o.wo_no, o.status, p.code AS product_code, p.name AS product_name, o.qty AS wo_qty, o.finished_qty, x.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, o.finished_qty * x.unit_qty AS std_qty, x.issued_qty AS actual_qty
FROM mes_wo_material x JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = x.wo_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = x.material_id JOIN wms_material p ON p.id = o.material_id WHERE ((o.status = 'COMPLETED' AND o.finish_time >= #{from} AND o.finish_time < #{to}) OR (o.status = 'CLOSED' AND o.close_time >= #{from} AND o.close_time < #{to})) AND o.material_id = #{q.productId} AND x.material_id = #{q.materialId}
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR o.wo_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY x.material_id ORDER BY material_code
ORDER BY o.wo_no, m.code
LIMIT #{limit}
